title: The Keller-Segel Model for Chemotaxis on Metapopulation Graphs and Graphons
summary: Many models of spatial populations use directed motion towards environmental attractants as a mechanism for spatial pattern formation. While prior approaches typically focus on partial differential equation models for directed motion in continuous space, it is natural to consider the dynamics of biological and social systems on a metapopulation featuring well-mixed local patches and spatial motion between patches.
